summary:
Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter feature in the repository. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative depth-first walk with explicit stack, 4 cells per indent level). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, VerticalCenter (render, measure, repr), and constrains Align's wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and explicit width). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in collected render options for print. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as UNRELEASED with an Added section listing both entries. Tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, VerticalCenter render and measure) and tests/test_tree.py (tree measurement expecting Measurement(11, 19)). Existing test expectations are unchanged. Not run: per instructions, no tests or repo code were executed, so verification is by reading only. The VerticalCenter render expectation "

foo


" is the most likely point of failure. Nothing was committed.
